svg.title: Why not just Claude or Codex?
svg.desc: Why not just Claude or Codex? Your researcher runs on them and adds what they do not keep. A plain assistant beside your researcher. Your library: a plain assistant forgets what it read; with your researcher, what you read becomes notes on your computer, and its answers cite them and name what is missing. You: a plain assistant starts from zero in each chat; your researcher keeps your questions, your voice and your rules in your own files, the same in every folder. Portability: change assistant or computer and a plain assistant starts again; your researcher moves to Claude, Codex or Antigravity, another account or another computer, and keeps everything, with a private copy on your GitHub. KaxaNuk's knowledge: a plain assistant knows what anyone knows; your researcher has skills for the eight-step process and for each Lab library, with their traps. A method: a plain assistant writes when asked; your researcher shows a plan and waits for your go, saves a version of each change, and for investing writes your claims before any test. For research and learning, never advice; what it reads goes to your assistant's company, never to KaxaNuk.
